purpose: Repair/build utility mallet with broad contact face for shelter/storm interactions.
readability: Broad squat head and short handle must read as repair tool, not combat weapon.
No claw, spike, blade or pointed peen.
Repair contact surfaces remain visually distinct by form/edge treatment, not color alone.

interactionIntent.useMode: short one-hand repair strikes; exact gesture/velocity thresholds are Unity-owned
interactionIntent.offHand: optional stabilization not required by source contract
interactionIntent.impactAuthority: replicate logical repair result/state, not raw impact physics

runtimeConstraints: Keep impact VFX small and readable on Quest 2.
Haptics/runtime hit tuning belongs to Claude and requires device QA.
acceptanceForSource: OBJ parses and retains broad-head/short-handle metre-scale bounds.
Named grip and two contact-face object groups exist.
Machine contract keeps runtime/device decisions with Claude.
